justification: Nobody's flipping me out of my own decisions again — Herbert's sitting there at 16.84 whispering sweet nothings and I know exactly what that is, that's the same trick that got me last week, so Mayfield stays, final answer, don't ask twice. Nico Collins is Out and bad luck for two more weeks minimum, I don't care what the tag says now, I watched him bagel me on a "sure thing" restart and I'm not doing that to myself again — Kraft and London already locked in early anyway, so it's academic. DJ Moore's Questionable but the alternative is Rachaad White at five points, and even I'm not paranoid enough to torch a ten-point floor for that, so he flexes. Montgomery, Kyren, Worthy, Gay, the Titans D — nobody's touching them, this is the most boring lineup I've ever turned in and for once boring feels like the safe move instead of the setup.
